correctness.rationale: Compact interior support makes x, y, and z uniformly positive, so arbitrary one-coordinate antiderivative tests with derivatives phi(x)/x, psi(y)/y, and chi(z)/z are legitimate. They give the three conditional per-capita growth laws exactly. The residual identities are direct rearrangements of the ODE and conditional orthogonality gives the variance budgets. Zero defect makes the corresponding coordinate constant on complete support trajectories; strict monotonicity of the Holling responses and bounded completeness then force all coordinates constant, hence equilibrium support. The break-even mean bound is Jensen's inequality for a strictly increasing strictly concave Holling response, and the periodic crossing theorem follows by integrating zdot/z over a period. The packaged exact checker verifies the residual algebra, curvature, and classical parameter specialization.

value.rationale: The Hastings–Powell model is a canonical example where trophic interactions produce coexisting periodic and chaotic behavior, so exact stationary diagnostics that do not depend on selecting one attractor are mathematically and ecologically natural. The theorem resolves each trophic transfer on the fiber of the population it directly drives, and identifies the unresolved part exactly with per-capita population-speed energy. For the top predator it also converts break-even growth into a finite-amplitude statement: every genuinely time-dependent stationary state has mean middle-trophic density strictly above the predator break-even density, while every positive cycle must cross that density. These provide exact consistency checks for simulated periodic and chaotic food-chain statistics beyond local equilibrium or bifurcation analysis.
